steps.title: Baseline Snapshot & Feature Flag Provisioning
steps.description: Capture pre-migration state, configure dynamic routing flag, and establish telemetry.
steps.rollback_action: Disable feature flag and drop telemetry probes

steps.title: Deploy Compatibility Shim / Adapter Interface
steps.description: Deploy non-breaking translation shim to preserve consumer contracts during evolution.
steps.rollback_action: De-register shim and restore legacy direct bindings

steps.title: Dual-Execution / Shadow Traffic Shadowing
steps.description: Route transactions to new architectural component in shadow mode alongside legacy path.
steps.rollback_action: Set shadow traffic sample rate to 0%

steps.title: Continuous Verification & Invariant Proof
steps.description: Execute automated regression suite and verify absence of behavioral drift (F62).
steps.rollback_action: Revert shadow comparison listener

steps.title: Incremental Canary Traffic Cutover
steps.description: Incrementally promote new architectural component from 10% to 100% active traffic.
steps.rollback_action: Trigger automated canary rollback to 100% legacy path on anomaly

steps.title: Post-Cutover Soak & Boundary Audit
steps.description: Observe 24-hour soak period, confirming decoupled SCC metrics and zero memory leaks.
steps.rollback_action: Execute full blue-green cutback to legacy fallback container

steps.title: Legacy Path Decommissioning & Contract Purge
steps.description: Remove obsolete legacy classes, deprecated methods, and transitional adapters.
steps.rollback_action: Restore legacy source code from git commit checkpoint
